mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate below 0.5% indicates an accommodative monetary policy that reduces the risk-free rate, lowering equity discount rates and boosting S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods with FEDFUNDS < 0.5% are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate exceeds 7.5%, it signals a deteriorating labor market that increases economic uncertainty and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods with UNRATE > 7.5% are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of a federal funds rate below 0.5% and consumer price index below 210 indicates a stable inflation environment with accommodative monetary policy, which is associated with positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: In a recession regime defined by unemployment rate above 7.5% and negative quarterly GDP growth, the S&P 500 exhibits negative forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to heightened economic risk.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in recession regimes (as defined) are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A high level of non-farm payrolls (PAYEMS) signals improving economic conditions and leads to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods with high PAYEMS are not significantly positive (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When industrial production (INDPRO) falls below 100, it indicates a contraction in manufacturing and services, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns in periods with INDPRO < 100 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: A combination of housing starts below 500 thousand units and residential sales below 300 billion dollars indicates a weak housing market, which is a leading indicator of economic slowdown and leads to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns in periods meeting the trigger condition are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the consumer price index (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 215, it signals accelerating inflation, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days due to increased risk of monetary tightening.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns in periods with CPIAUCSL > 215 are not significantly negative (t-test p > 0.05) or the Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.
